_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: I want to use Claude Code on my Roblox game from VS Code with Git. Should I use Script Sync or Rojo?
start a new roblox project with rojo and the usual tools pinned
Run selene and luau-lsp on my Roblox project and tell me what fails.
expectations: the roblox-agent-project skill is not invoked (roblox-agent-checks' job)

evals.prompt: Set up a new Vite project with TypeScript.
expectations: the roblox-agent-project skill is not invoked (not Roblox)

evals.prompt: Look at this folder and tell me which Roblox sync route it already uses before changing anything.
expectations: the skill looked for *.project.json and a toolchain manifest before recommending, proven by the tool call

evals.prompt: I have Rojo serving my scripts and I also let Claude edit the same scripts through the Studio MCP. Is that fine?
expectations: says no: one writer per script, Rojo's next sync overwrites one side
routes script edits to disk and MCP to non-script instances
regex on the answer: (?i)(one writer|overwrit|clobber|both sides|two writers)
